name: pmjob-story-bank
description: Builds your Interview Story Bank, eight to twelve stories from your evidence rows in a two minute and a thirty second version, tagged by competency, with likely follow-up questions and the facts you must not stretch. Use for "run pmjob-story-bank", "build my interview stories", "STAR stories for a product interview", "I always tell the same launch story", "stories for behavioural questions", "story about a failure", "story about a disagreement", "shorten my interview story", part of the Claude Guide for Product Interviews Pack by 90n.
